api_method_source: LinkedIn publishes NO official OpenAPI/llms.txt/Postman collection for Voyager (it is an internal, unofficial API). The surface this CLI targets was enumerated from the cliwright build brief plus community reverse-engineering of the linkedin.com web client (2026-07). Job-search surface: the voyagerJobsDashJobCards search endpoint, the jobs/jobPostings/{id} detail endpoint, the organization/companies universalName lookup, and the jobs-guest geo typeahead. Messaging surface: the CURRENT GraphQL 'messenger' endpoints the web app now uses — voyagerMessagingGraphQL/graphql for conversations list + thread read (queryId hashes that ROTATE on LinkedIn's frontend build) and voyagerMessagingDashMessengerMessages?action=createMessage for send. The legacy keyVersion=LEGACY_INBOX conversations/events endpoints are DEAD (HTTP 500 live 2026-07-22) and were replaced; queryIds/URLs pinned from the maintained mautrix/linkedin bridge (pkg/linkedingo). The GraphQL calls depend on an internal GET /me to resolve the caller's fsd_profile mailbox URN (a dependency, not a user-facing method). NO live LinkedIn request was made during the build. See DECISIONS.md #27-#29.
